context: Tests whether the agent uses the correct Codex CLI command syntax for both initial reviews and follow-up sessions, correctly parses JSONL to extract session IDs, enforces iteration limits, and manages state appropriately in the automation script.

checklist.name: codex exec review command
checklist.description: Script uses 'codex exec review' (not just 'codex review' or another variant) for the initial review invocation

checklist.name: --json flag in review command
checklist.description: The initial 'codex exec review' call includes the '--json' flag

checklist.name: Output redirected to .codex-review/review-output.md
checklist.description: The review command uses '-o .codex-review/review-output.md' to direct output to the correct file

checklist.name: stderr suppressed
checklist.description: The review command includes '2>/dev/null' to suppress stderr output

checklist.name: session_meta line detection
checklist.description: The script parses JSONL stdout by looking for a line containing '"type": "session_meta"' (or equivalent pattern) to extract the session_id

checklist.name: codex exec resume for follow-ups
checklist.description: Follow-up iterations use 'codex exec resume' (not a new 'codex exec review') with the session ID as an argument

checklist.name: Session ID passed to resume
checklist.description: The session_id extracted from the JSONL output is used as the argument to 'codex exec resume <SESSION_ID>'

checklist.name: Resume includes fixed items list
checklist.description: The message passed to 'codex exec resume' includes a reference to the findings that were addressed/fixed

checklist.name: Resume includes skipped items list
checklist.description: The message passed to 'codex exec resume' includes a reference to the findings that were intentionally skipped with reasons

checklist.name: Maximum 3 iterations enforced
checklist.description: The loop has an explicit stop condition that prevents more than 3 total iterations (initial + 2 follow-ups)

checklist.name: .codex-review directory created
checklist.description: The script creates the '.codex-review/' directory (e.g., via 'mkdir -p .codex-review') before writing files to it
